data.description:
Goodra is a bipedal, draconic Pokémon that is coated with slime. Most of his body is pale purple with a darker purple underside. He has bright green eyes, two green spots on each cheek, a relatively long neck, and a short, rounded snout. On top of his head are two pairs of antenna-like horns. The foremost horns are small nubs, but the hind horns are longer, thicker, and curve down his neck. The tips of the larger horns are slightly curled. He has proportionally short limbs with two digits each and a large, thick tail with a curled tip. Along each side of his tail are three green spots. A pale green slime is usually visible dripping from his chin and arms. Goodra are known for having a great affinity for water, being able to live within water with no difficulty at all, as well as dive and surf all around the area. Because of their meek, friendly nature, Goodra are often teased for supposed weakness. Goodra are known to be very friendly. When they grows close to someone, they will hug them and leave them coated in slime. Goodra usually misunderstand instructions, appearing dazed or bewildered. Despite this, many Trainers don't mind it, instead finding this behavior to be adorable. However, they will strike at their tormentors with their retractable horns and powerful tail. Dragonite is a draconic, bipedal reptilian Pokémon with light orange skin. He has large, grayish-green eyes and a round snout with small nostrils. A pair of long, thin antennae sprout from the top of his head with a small horn set between them. His striated underbelly is cream-colored and extends from his neck to the tip of his long, tapering tail. He has thick arms and legs ending in three claws each. The leg joints are well-defined, while his arms have a smooth, rounded appearance. Dragonite's wings are small relative to his body with teal wing membranes. Despite his bulky build, Dragonite is capable of flying faster than the speed of sound, being able to circle the globe in sixteen hours. A kindhearted Pokémon with human-like intelligence, Dragonite shows signs of altruism: he is said to save humans from drowning and lead lost or foundering ships to safety. However, he will go on an uncontrollable, destructive rampage if his environment is threatened. Dragonite will usually calm down and be satisfied after smashing down anything that has angered him to smithereens. He is known to engage in fierce battles with Kingdra whenever they meet.
